text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: S-So, you're the one who should give up already!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そっちこそ！　
そろそろ諦めたらどうなのよ！？

text_block_list.name: Chuuji
text_block_list.text: I wish we could do that. , but... we can't stop anymore.  We...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうできたらよかったのかもしれんな。
だが……
もう止まることはできん。
俺たちは……

text_block_list.name: Chuuji
text_block_list.text: We didn't want this to happen either. , but as long as we live in this world... we don't have any other choice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺たちも望んでこうなったわけじゃない。
だがこの世界に生きる以上……
他に手段はないのだ。

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: ...It's a pity, isn't it?  You can't stop it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんだか、
気の毒ですね……
やめられないんですか？

text_block_list.name: Chuuza
text_block_list.text: That's right... There's no other way now!  Don't think bad of us...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その通り……
もはや他に道はない！
悪く思うなよ……！

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: Except for winning, it seems there's no way to stop us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちが勝つ以外に、
止めてあげられる方法は
なさそうですね……

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: This feels like the final plan.  So, we can't afford to lose! Let's show them what we're made of!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが最終手段って感じよね。
だから、
絶対負けられないわ！
アタシたちの底力、
見せてやりましょ！
